R1.question:

ⓐ Don't ask why are they arguing.
ⓑ I don't know when the store opens.
ⓒ Her voice made the audience silently.
ⓓ The barking dog kept the baby awake.
ⓔ Please tell me what happened last night.

2개
3개
4개
5개
